description: This file defines an interface for reading report mailing job configurations in the Fineract project, including methods to retrieve all configurations and to retrieve a specific configuration by name.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobConfigurationReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to access report mailing job configurations.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobConfigurations
methods.description: Returns a collection of all report mailing job configurations.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific report mailing job configuration by its name.
